source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 8 exercise solved (PDF 189-191), with the printed numerical answers checked.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Physical Optics and Gravitational Waves) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed response aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) hain; har numerical step ba step hal hai aur kitab ke jawab se mila kar dekha gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Choose the correct option. (Sahi option chunein.)

blocks.prompt:
8.1 The phenomenon of polarization of light is:
(Roshni ki polarization ka mazhar (phenomenon) kya hai?)

options.text: roshni ka ek khaas plane mein vibrate karne ki khasiyat
roshni ka seedhi line mein chalne ki salahiyat

blocks.explanation: Polarization woh amal hai jis mein roshni ki vibrations (electric field) ek hi plane tak mehdood ho jati hain (8.1).

blocks.prompt:
8.2 Malus's law states that:
(Malus ka qanoon kya kehta hai?)

options.text: roshni ki intensity light wave aur analyzer ke darmiyan angle ke cosine ke square ke seedhe mutanasib hai
intensity us angle ke sine ke square ke seedhe mutanasib hai
intensity us angle ke seedhe mutanasib hai
intensity us angle ke ulte (inversely) mutanasib hai

blocks.explanation: Malus ka qanoon: I ∝ cos²θ, I = I₀cos²θ, jahan θ polarizer (polarized roshni ka plane) aur analyzer ke transmission axes ke darmiyan angle hai (8.5).

blocks.prompt:
8.3 The intensity of light when it passes through a polarizer:
(Polarizer se guzarne par roshni ki intensity:)
blocks.explanation: Polarizer sirf apne axis ke parallel vibrations guzarne deta hai aur baqi rok leta hai, is liye intensity ghat jati hai (unpolarized roshni ki aadhi, I₀/2).

blocks.prompt:
8.4 The angle between the light wave and the analyzer is called:
(Light wave aur analyzer ke darmiyan angle ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Polarized roshni ke plane aur analyzer ke axis ke darmiyan angle θ (Malus ke qanoon wala θ) analyzer ka rukh batata hai aur isay azimuth angle kehte hain. Chapter (8.4) ka 'polarizing angle' Brewster ka angle of incidence hai, yeh angle nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Options "a)", "(b)", "b)", "(d)" chhape hain: teesra option (reflection angle) asal mein (c) hai. Chapter is angle ka naam nahi deta; analyzer ke angle ke liye mutadawil (standard) lafz azimuth angle (d) hai, jabke polarizing angle Brewster ka angle hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.5 The key purpose of an analyzer in a polarization experiment is:
(Polarization ke tajurbe mein analyzer ka asal maqsad kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Roshni ko polarizer polarize karta hai; analyzer (doosra polarizer) ghuma kar guzarne wali intensity ki tabdeeli, I = I₀cos²θ, dekhi jati hai taake polarized roshni ka jaiza liya jaye aur intensity adjust ho (8.3, 8.5).

blocks.prompt:
8.6 The mathematical representation of Malus's law is:
(Malus ke qanoon ki riyazi (mathematical) shakal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Analyzer se sirf A₀cosθ component guzarta hai aur intensity ∝ amplitude², is liye I = I₀cos²θ (8.5).

blocks.prompt:
8.7 The effect of increasing the angle between the light wave and the analyzer on the intensity of light is:
(Light wave aur analyzer ka angle barhane se intensity par kya asar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: θ 0° se 90° tak barhe to cos²θ ghatta hai, is liye I = I₀cos²θ ghatti hai (zero sirf θ = 90° par hoti hai).

blocks.prompt:
8.8 The condition for maximum intensity of light in a polarization experiment is when:
(Polarization ke tajurbe mein maximum intensity ki shart kya hai?)

options.text: light wave aur analyzer perpendicular hon
light wave aur analyzer parallel hon

blocks.explanation: θ = 0° (parallel) par cos²0° = 1 aur I = I₀, sab se zyada (8.5). 90° (perpendicular) par I = 0.

blocks.prompt:
8.9 The unwanted light that interferes with vision is termed as:
(Woh ghair zaroori roshni jo dekhne mein rukawat dale, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter glare ko woh ghair zaroori roshni kehta hai jo dekhne mein rukawat dale (8.5, Imaging and Microscopy).

blocks.prompt:
8.10 Who predicted the existence of gravitational waves?
(Gravitational waves ke wujood ki peshgoi kis ne ki?)
blocks.explanation: Albert Einstein ne 1916 mein general theory of relativity se gravitational waves ki peshgoi ki; pehli dafa 2015 mein detect hui (8.6).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Naam ghalat chhape hain: "Issac Newton" asal mein Isaac Newton aur "Leonardo da Venci" asal mein Leonardo da Vinci hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.11 What are gravitational waves?
(Gravitational waves kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gravitational waves spacetime ke fabric mein lehrein hain jo shadeed cosmic waqiat se paida hoti hain aur roshni ki speed se chalti hain (8.6).

blocks.prompt:
8.12 Which is the primary method used to detect gravitational waves?
(Gravitational waves detect karne ka bunyadi tareeqa kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: LIGO aur Virgo LASER interferometers hain: gravitational wave arms ki lambai thori badalti hai jis se interference pattern badal jata hai (8.7).

blocks.prompt:
8.13 Which of the following is a primary source of gravitational waves?
(In mein se gravitational waves ka bunyadi source kaun sa hai?)

options.text: Binary black hole merger (do black holes ka milap)

blocks.explanation: Milne wale binary systems (black holes, neutron stars) sab se ahem sources hain; 2015 mein pehli detect hone wali waves do black holes ke milap se aayi thin (8.6, 8.7). Supernovae kamzor burst waves dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: "Earthquack" chhapa hai; sahi lafz Earthquake (zalzala) hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.1 Why are the polaroid sunglasses better than the ordinary sunglasses?
Polaroid sunglasses aam sunglasses se behtar kyun hain?
blocks.explanation:
Paani, sarak ya barf se reflect hone wali chamak (glare) satah ke parallel (horizontal) partially polarized hoti hai. Polaroid lenses ka transmission axis khara (vertical) hota hai, is liye yeh glare rok lete hain (I = I₀cos²90° = 0) aur baqi roshni guzarne dete hain.
Aam kaale chashme sirf har roshni ko barabar kam karte hain, glare khatam nahi karte.

blocks.prompt:
8.2 Is light from the sky partially polarized? How is it so?
Kya aasman ki roshni partially polarized hai? Kaise?
blocks.explanation:
Haan. Dhoop fizaa ke hawa ke molecules aur chhote zarrat se bikharti (scatter hoti) hai aur scattering roshni ko polarize karti hai (8.5). Is liye aasman ki roshni partially polarized hoti hai, Suraj ki simt se 90° par sab se zyada.
Ghoomte polaroid se aasman dekhein to roshni kam zyada hoti nazar aati hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.3 How is Malus's law used in everyday life?
Malus ka qanoon rozmarra zindagi mein kaise istemal hota hai?
blocks.explanation:
Malus ka qanoon (I = I₀cos²θ) polarizer ghuma kar roshni ki intensity control karne deta hai:
1. Polarized sunglasses glare kam karte hain.
2. Camera ke polarizing filters sky photography mein glare aur dhund kam karte hain.
3. LCD screens polarizers ke angle se har pixel ki roshni tay karti hain.
4. Do ghoomte polaroids dimmer ka kaam karte hain; stress analysis aur microscopy mein bhi istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.4 What are the applications of Brewster's angle?
Brewster's angle ke istemalat kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Reflection se plane polarized roshni banana: θₚ ≈ 57° par shisha (glass plate) polarizer ka kaam karta hai.
2. Medium ka refractive index maloom karna: n = tan θₚ (Example 8.2).
3. Glare kam karna: Brewster angle ke qareeb reflect hone wali chamak zyada polarized hoti hai, is liye polaroid chashme aur camera filters isay rok lete hain.
4. Lasers mein Brewster windows polarized roshni ko reflection ke nuqsan ke baghair guzarti hain (chapter se bahar).

blocks.prompt:
8.5 What is the space-time curvature?
Space-time curvature kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Einstein ki general theory of relativity ke mutabiq gravity koi force nahi balke bhari ajsaam ki wajah se spacetime ka mur jana (curvature) hai, jaise bhari gend gadde mein garha bana deti hai. Doosre ajsaam is mure hue spacetime mein chalte hain, jisay hum gravity mehsoos karte hain.
Tez hoti (accelerating) masses is curvature mein lehrein bhejti hain: gravitational waves.

blocks.prompt:
8.1 Write down some applications of plane polarized and circularly polarized light.
Plane polarized aur circularly polarized roshni ke kuch istemalat likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Plane (linearly) polarized roshni:
1. Polaroid sunglasses: paani aur sarak ki chamak (glare) kam karte hain.
2. Sky photography mein camera polarizing filters: glare aur dhund kam, contrast behtar.
3. LCD screens crossed polarizers istemal karti hain.
4. Stress analysis (photoelasticity): dabao wale plastic ya shishe se polarized roshni guzar kar stress ke patterns aur nuqs dikhati hai.
5. Optical activity: cheeni (sugar) ke mehlool ki concentration maloom karna.
6. Polarizing microscopes aur medical imaging (cancer ki tashkhees, tissue imaging).
Circularly polarized roshni:
1. CD ya DVD se reflect hone wali roshni circularly polarized hoti hai; optical discs parhne mein kaam aati hai (8.2).
2. 3D cinema ke chashme dono aankhon ke liye left aur right handed circular polarization istemal karte hain (chapter se bahar).
3. Satellite aur optical communication, kyunke signal receiver ke rukh par munhasir nahi hota (chapter se bahar).
4. Auto-focus cameras ke circular polarizing filters (chapter se bahar).

blocks.prompt:
8.2 Would it be possible to use a polarizer as an analyzer? If yes, give at least two examples.
Kya polarizer ko analyzer ke taur par istemal kiya ja sakta hai? Agar haan to kam az kam do misalein dein.
blocks.explanation:
Haan. Analyzer sirf ek polarizer hai jo doosre polarizer ke baad rakha jaye (8.5); har polaroid sheet apni jagah ke lihaz se dono kaam kar sakti hai. Doosri sheet ko analyzer is liye kehte hain ke us se jaancha (analyze kiya) jata hai ke roshni polarized hai ya nahi aur kis plane mein.
Misalein:
1. Do polaroid sheets: pehli se guzar kar unpolarized roshni plane polarized ho jati hai; doosri (analyzer) ghumane se roshni madham hoti hai aur axes perpendicular hone par ghaib ho jati hai (Fig. 8.5).
2. Malus ka reflection wala tajurba: taqreeban 57° par shishe se reflect roshni ko ghoomte polaroid se dekha jaye to ek jagah woh bujh jati hai, yani plane polarized hai (8.4).
3. LCD screen (jis ki roshni polarized hai) ke aage polaroid chashme ka lens ghumayein to ek angle par screen kaali nazar aati hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.3 Explain how Malus's law is used in the design of polarized sunglasses. How do these surfaces reduce glare from reflective surface? Provide an example to illustrate your answer.
Polarized sunglasses ke design mein Malus ka qanoon kaise istemal hota hai? Yeh reflect karne wali satah ki chamak (glare) kaise kam karte hain? Misal se wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Design: Polarized sunglasses ke lenses polaroid sheets hain jin ka transmission axis khara (vertical) hota hai.
Glare: Ufuqi (horizontal) satah (paani, geeli sarak, barf, gaari ka bonnet) se reflect roshni satah ke parallel yani horizontal partially polarized hoti hai (8.3, Ponder Upon).
Malus ka qanoon: I = I₀cos²θ. Glare ke liye us ke vibration plane (horizontal) aur lens ke axis (vertical) ka angle θ = 90° hai, is liye
I = I₀cos²90° = 0
Glare ruk jata hai. Doosri cheezon ki aam unpolarized roshni sirf taqreeban aadhi hoti hai, is liye manzar saaf aur behtar contrast ke sath nazar aata hai.
Misal: Dhoop wali jheel par polarized chashma pehne machhera: paani ki satah ki tez chamak kat jati hai aur woh paani ke andar machhliyan dekh leta hai. Isi tarah geeli sarak par driver ko chundhiyane wali chamak ke baghair sarak saaf dikhti hai. Agar woh sar 90° jhuka le to glare wapas aa jata hai; yeh Malus ka qanoon hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.4 How will the sky appear if there had been no atmosphere?
Agar fizaa (atmosphere) na hoti to aasman kaisa nazar aata?
blocks.explanation:
Aasman din mein bhi kaala (andhera) nazar aata.
Neela aur roshan aasman fizaa ke hawa ke molecules aur zarrat se dhoop ke bikharne (scattering) ki wajah se hai. Fizaa na ho to scattering nahi hogi aur aasman ke baqi hisson se koi roshni aankh tak nahi pohnchegi: Suraj kaale aasman par ek bohat roshan disc nazar aata aur din mein sitare dikhte, jaise Chaand par astronauts dekhte hain. Aasman ki polarized roshni bhi na hoti. (Neele rang ki wajah chapter se bahar hai.)

blocks.prompt:
8.5 What is the significance of detecting gravitational waves?
Gravitational waves detect karne ki kya ahmiyat hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. LIGO ki 2015 ki detection ne Einstein ki general theory of relativity ki 100 saal purani bari peshgoi ki tasdeeq ki; is par 2017 ka Nobel Prize mila.
2. Kainaat ko dekhne ki nayi khirki khulti hai: black holes aur neutron stars ke takrao jaise shadeed waqiat, jo bohat kam ya bilkul roshni nahi dete, ab parhe ja sakte hain.
3. Waves apne source ki maloomat lati hain: masses, spin, orbital period aur merger ka amal.
4. Taqatwar gravity (strong-field gravity) aur general relativity ko test kiya ja sakta hai.
5. Yeh roshni ki speed se spacetime mein azaadi se chalti hain aur maadda (matter) inhein mushkil se rokta hai, is liye kainaat ke bohat door aur purane hisson ki khabar lati hain (masalan 1.3 billion saal safar karne wali waves).

blocks.prompt:
8.6 How are tidal forces formed?
Tidal forces kaise bante hain?
blocks.explanation:
Jab gravitational wave kisi mass wale jism se guzarti hai to jism ke gird spacetime ko oscillate karti hai. Jism baqaida waqfon se ek simt mein khinchta aur us ke perpendicular simt mein dabta hai (dono simtein wave ke chalne ki simt ke perpendicular). Is baqaida khinchao aur dabao (spacetime distortion) ko tidal forces kehte hain (8.6).
Yeh Zameen par samandar ke jawar bhatay (tides) jaisa hai jo Zameen ke mukhtalif hisson par Chaand aur Suraj ki kashish (gravitational pull) ke farq se aate hain.
Asar wave ki taqat aur jism ke mass aur size par munhasir hai. Zameen tak aane wali waves ka asar bohat chhota hai (strain taqreeban 10⁻²¹ se 10⁻²²), is liye LIGO jaise bohat hassas (sensitive) aalaat chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
8.1 Define the phenomenon of polarization of waves. How does polarization of electromagnetic waves occur? Also classify the polarization of waves.
Waves ki polarization ki taareef karein. Electromagnetic waves ki polarization kaise hoti hai? Polarization ki aqsaam bhi bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Taareef: Polarization woh amal hai jis mein transverse wave ki vibrations ek hi plane tak mehdood ho jati hain. Roshni mein electric aur magnetic vibrations ek plane mein qaid ho jati hain. Yeh sirf transverse waves (roshni, string ki waves) mein hoti hai, longitudinal waves jaise awaz mein kabhi nahi. Vibration ki simt aur chalne ki simt wala plane, plane of polarization kehlata hai.
Electromagnetic waves kaise polarize hoti hain:
1. Oscillating charge se bani roshni electric field E aur magnetic field B par mushtamil hai jo aapas mein aur chalne ki simt se 90° par hain.
2. Aam roshni (dhoop, bulb, mom batti) mein E har mumkin plane mein vibrate karta hai: yeh unpolarized hai.
3. Unpolarized roshni polarizing filter (polaroid sheet) se guzre to sirf filter ke axis ke parallel E guzarta hai, baqi ruk jate hain. Nikalne wali roshni ek plane mein vibrate karti hai: yeh polarized hai.
4. Roshni polarizing beam splitter, optical crystals (calcite, quartz, tourmaline) se, aur qudrati taur par reflection, refraction aur scattering se bhi polarize hoti hai.
Electric field vector E ka ek khaas simt mein hona polarization ki bunyad hai.
Polarization ki aqsaam:
1. Linear polarization: E ek hi plane mein oscillate karta hai. Misal: sunglasses jaise filter se guzri roshni.
2. Circular polarization: E circle mein ghoomta hai, clockwise (right-handed) ya anticlockwise (left-handed). Misal: CD ya DVD se reflect roshni.
3. Elliptical polarization: linear aur circular ka milap; E ka sira ellipse banata hai kyunke us ke components Eₓ aur E_y barabar nahi aur/ya un mein phase ka farq hai. Misal: stress plate ya waveplate se guzri roshni.

blocks.prompt:
8.2 How can the plane polarized light be produced and detected? What does it prove?
Plane polarized roshni kaise paida aur detect ki jati hai? Is se kya sabit hota hai?
blocks.explanation:
Paida karna: Aam incandescent bulb ya Suraj ki roshni unpolarized hoti hai, us ki electric vibrations har simt mein be-tarteeb hoti hain. Jab yeh polaroid sheet (polarizer) par parti hai to sirf us ke axis ke parallel vibrations guzarti hain aur guzarne wali roshni plane polarized ho jati hai.
Detect karna: Is roshni ke raaste mein doosra polaroid (analyzer) rakha jata hai.
1. Polarizer aur analyzer ke axes parallel hon to roshni analyzer se guzar jati hai (sab se zyada roshni).
2. Analyzer ko beam ke gird aahista ghumayein to roshni madham se madham hoti jati hai.
3. Axes perpendicular (crossed) ho jayein to roshni bilkul ghaib ho jati hai.
4. Mazeed ghumane par roshni wapas aati hai aur axes dobara parallel hone par sab se tez hoti hai.
Analyzer ghumane par roshni ka kam zyada hona batata hai ke polarizer se nikalne wali roshni plane polarized hai (yeh I = I₀cos²θ ke mutabiq hai).
Is se kya sabit hota hai: Roshni ki waves transverse hain. Agar roshni longitudinal hoti (chalne ki simt mein vibrate karti) to har rukh par barabar guzarti aur crossed polaroids par bhi kabhi ghaib na hoti.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Do kanghiyon (combs) ki misal: agar rassi ki lehar khari (vertical) ho aur pehli kanghi ke daante bhi khare hon to lehar guzar jati hai; doosri kanghi ke daante leite (horizontal) hon to lehar ruk jati hai. Sirf transverse lehar hi is tarah rukti hai, is liye roshni transverse hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.3 How can polarized light be obtained by the method of reflection? Explain.
Reflection ke tareeqe se polarized roshni kaise hasil ki jati hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Malus (1808) ne dekha ke shishe ki plane sheet se reflect hone wali aam roshni polarized hoti hai. Agar reflect roshni ko nazar ki line ke gird aahista ghoomte polaroid se dekha jaye to ek jagah woh taqreeban bujh jati hai. Shishe ke liye yeh sab se achha taqreeban 57° angle of incidence par hota hai, jahan reflected ray plane polarized hoti hai (vibrations plane of incidence ke perpendicular). Mez ki satah se reflect roshni sirf partially polarized hoti hai.
Brewster ka qanoon: Jis angle of incidence par reflect roshni (taqreeban) plane polarized ho, use polarizing angle θₚ (Brewster angle θ_B) kehte hain. Is angle par reflected aur refracted rays aapas mein 90° par hoti hain:
θₚ + θᵣ = 90°, is liye θᵣ = 90° − θₚ
Snell ka qanoon: n₁ sin θₚ = n₂ sin θᵣ
n₁ sin θₚ = n₂ sin(90° − θₚ) = n₂ cos θₚ
sin θₚ / cos θₚ = n₂/n₁
tan θₚ = n₂/n₁ (Brewster ka qanoon)
Agar medium 1 hawa ho (n₁ = 1, n₂ = n): tan θₚ = n.
Yani polarizing angle ka tangent reflect karne wale medium ke refractive index ke barabar hai. Shisha (n = 1.5): θₚ = tan⁻¹1.5 ≈ 56.3° (taqreeban 57°); paani (n = 1.33): θₚ ≈ 53°.

blocks.prompt:
8.4 State Malus's law. Explain the intensity formula.
Malus ka qanoon bayan karein. Intensity ka formula wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Bayan: Analyzer se guzarne ke baad plane polarized roshni ki intensity I, analyzer aur polarizer ke transmission axes ke darmiyan angle θ ke cosine ke square ke seedhe mutanasib hoti hai.
I ∝ cos²θ, ya I = I₀cos²θ
jahan I₀ analyzer par parne wali (polarizer ke baad wali) polarized roshni ki intensity hai.
Saboot:
1. Amplitude A₀ wali polarized roshni analyzer par parti hai jis ka axis plane of polarization se angle θ banata hai.
2. Amplitude do components mein toot jata hai: analyzer ke axis ke parallel A₀cosθ aur perpendicular A₀sinθ.
3. A₀sinθ jazb (absorb) ho jata hai; sirf A₀cosθ guzarta hai. Is liye guzarne wala amplitude A = A₀cosθ.
4. Intensity amplitude ke square ke mutanasib hai, I = A²:
I = A₀²cos²θ
I = I₀cos²θ (kyunke I₀ = A₀²)
Formula ki wazahat:
- θ = 0° (axes parallel): cos²0° = 1, I = I₀ (sab se zyada; saari polarized roshni guzarti hai).
- θ = 90° (axes crossed): cos²90° = 0, I = 0 (roshni bilkul ruk jati hai).
- Darmiyan mein, masalan θ = 45°: I = I₀/2; θ = 60°: I = I₀/4.
Yani analyzer ghuma kar roshni ki intensity control hoti hai. Note: agar I₀ intensity ki unpolarized roshni pehle polarizer par pare to us se sirf I₀/2 guzarti hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.5 What is a polaroid? Explain two main applications of polarization.
Polaroid kya hai? Polarization ke do bare istemalat wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Polaroid: Kuch shaffaf (transparent) crystalline maadde, jaise tourmaline aur calcite, apni crystal structure ki khaas simt (directionality) ki wajah se roshni ki vibrations ko sirf ek plane tak mehdood kar dete hain. Aise maadde (aur in se bani sheets) polaroids kehlate hain. Polaroid sheet sirf apne axis ke parallel electric vibrations guzarti hai, is liye unpolarized roshni ko plane polarized bana deti hai; isay polarizer ya analyzer dono tarah istemal kiya ja sakta hai.
Polarization ke do bare istemalat (polarizers):
1. Sky photography: Aasman aur badalon ki tasveer lene wale camera par polaroid filter lagaya jata hai. Aasman ki roshni fizaa ke chhote zarrat aur molecules se scatter ho kar polarized hoti hai jis se glare aur dhund (haze) banti hai. Polarizer yeh glare aur dhund kam karta hai aur zyada safed roshni rok kar baqi rang guzarne deta hai, is se contrast barhta hai aur tasveer roshan, tafseeli aur behtar quality ki banti hai.
2. Maaddon ka stress analysis (photoelasticity): Jab shaffaf maadde (plastic, shisha) par dabao (stress) pare to us ki molecular structure badalti hai, polarized roshni par us ka asar badalta hai aur interference fringes nazar aati hain. Polarized roshni guzar kar analyzer se dekhne par stress ke patterns, kamzor jagahein ya nuqs, optical khususiyat aur mukhtalif halaat mein rawaiya maloom hota hai. Engineering, materials science aur quality control mein istemal hota hai.
(Doosre istemalat: polarized sunglasses, LCD screens, medical imaging, astronomy.)

blocks.prompt:
8.6 What are gravitational waves? Describe the basic types of gravitational waves.
Gravitational waves kya hain? Gravitational waves ki bunyadi aqsaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Gravitational waves (GWs) spacetime ke fabric mein lehrein hain jo shadeed cosmic waqiat, jaise black holes ya neutron stars ke takrao se paida hoti hain, roshni ki speed se chalti hain aur apne source ki maloomat lati hain. Gravitational wave space ko khinchti aur dabati hai aur do ajsaam ke darmiyan faasle ki tabdeeli naap kar dekhi ja sakti hai.
Einstein ne 1916 mein general theory of relativity (gravity mass ki wajah se spacetime ka murna hai) se in ki peshgoi ki aur LIGO ne pehli dafa 14 September 2015 ko do milte hue black holes se aane wali waves detect keen. Har tez hota (accelerating) mass GWs banata hai, magar Zameen ki cheezon ki waves detect karne ke liye bohat kamzor hain. Zameen par in ka amplitude bohat chhota hai (strain taqreeban 10⁻²¹ se 10⁻²²).
Misal: talab mein phenka pathar (cosmic waqia) paani (spacetime) par lehrein banata hai jo kinare par (observatories) mehsoos hoti hain.
Chaar bunyadi aqsaam:
1. Continuous GWs: ek bhari jism jo ek jaisi raftar se ghoome, jaise neutron star; frequency aur amplitude qaim rehte hain. White dwarf binary systems bhi yeh banate hain.
2. Compact binary inspiral GWs: binary systems (do neutron stars, do black holes, ya neutron star aur black hole) jo ek doosre ke gird ghoomte hue andar ki taraf ghoomte (spiral) aate hain; merger tak frequency aur amplitude barhte jate hain.
3. Burst GWs: shadeed waqiat jaise supernovae, gamma-ray bursts ya cosmic strings se mukhtasar signals.
4. Stochastic GWs: bohat se kamzor sources (jaise door ke binary systems) ke superposition se bane kamzor, be-tarteeb signals; detect karna sab se mushkil.

blocks.prompt:
8.7 What is an interferometer? Describe the basic Michelson's interferometer in detail.
Interferometer kya hai? Bunyadi Michelson interferometer ko tafseel se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Interferometer: ek optical aala, bohat hassas detection device, jo roshni (LASER) ki beams ke interference se faasle ki nihayat chhoti tabdeeliyan naapta hai. Yeh gravitational waves detect karne mein istemal hota hai.
Bunyadi hisse (Michelson / gravitational-wave interferometer):
1. LASER: mustaqil aur tez roshni ki beam banata hai.
2. Power recycling mirror: aale mein se guzri hui laser roshni ko wapas andar bhejta hai (recycling), is se power barhti hai.
3. Beam splitter: laser beam ko do perpendicular beams mein baant deta hai.
4. Mirrors (input aur end mirrors): beams ko reflect kar ke do perpendicular arms banate hain.
5. Fabry-Perot (arm) cavities: har arm mein aamne saamne do mirrors; roshni kai baar aati jati hai, is se raaste ki lambai aur hassasiyat barhti hai.
6. Photodetector: wapas mili beams ko naapta hai aur chhote phase shift pakarta hai.
Kaam ka tareeqa:
1. Laser beam do perpendicular beams mein bant kar do ek jaise arms mein chalti hai.
2. Har beam apne arm ke aakhir ke mirror se reflect ho kar beam splitter par wapas aati hai jahan dono mil jati hain.
3. Mili hui beams interfere kar ke interference pattern (fringes) banati hain jo photodetector naapta hai. Barabar arms par beams aisi rakhi jati hain ke ek doosre ko khatam karein aur detector par (taqreeban) roshni na aaye.
4. Gravitational wave guzre to ek arm ko thora khinchti aur doosre ko dabati hai. Is se path difference badalta hai, dono beams mein phase shift aata hai aur interference pattern badal jata hai; photodetector yeh tabdeeli pakar kar wave detect karta hai.
LIGO aur Virgo: LIGO (LASER Interferometer Gravitational-wave Observatory, USA) ke arms 4 km ke hain aur yeh aam interferometer se taqreeban 1000 guna bara hai, jo laser ke bajaye aam roshni istemal karta hai. Virgo (Pisa, Italy ke qareeb) ke arms 3 km ke hain. LIGO ne 14 September 2015 ko pehli dafa gravitational waves dekhin jo do takrate black holes se 1.3 billion saal mein pohnchi thin; Rainer Weiss, Barry C. Barish aur Kip S. Thorne ko 2017 ka Nobel Prize mila. Pakistani nazhad Professor Nergis Mavalvala (MIT) is team mein shamil thin.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Asal khayal: do raaste barabar hon to dono beams ek doosre ko mita deti hain (andhera). Gravitational wave ek raasta zara sa lamba aur doosra chhota kar deti hai, to mitana poora nahi hota aur detector par roshni aa jati hai. Yahi signal hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.8 What is meant by optical activity? Discuss it.
Optical activity se kya muraad hai? Is par bahas karein.
blocks.explanation:
Optical activity: kuch maaddon ki woh salahiyat jis se woh apne andar se guzarne wali roshni ke plane of polarization ko ghuma dete hain. Aise maadde optically active kehlate hain.
Pata lagana: Plane polarized roshni (polarizer se) maadde se guzar kar analyzer se dekhi jati hai. Polarizer aur analyzer crossed hon aur maadda na ho to roshni nahi guzarti. Optically active maadda darmiyan mein rakhein to roshni phir nazar aati hai, kyunke plane of polarization angle θ se ghoom gaya hai; roshni dobara rokne ke liye analyzer ko θ ghumana parta hai, is se rotation naapi jati hai (Fig. 8.8).
Misalein: quartz crystals, cinnabar (HgS), cheeni ka paani, insulin, collagen; cheeni aur tartaric acid mehlool (solution) mein optical rotation dikhate hain.
Rotation ki miqdar aur simt in par munhasir hai:
1. maadde ki qisam,
2. mehlool mein maadde ki concentration,
3. roshni maadde mein kitna faasla tay kare, aur
4. roshni ki wavelength.
Wajah: maadde ke molecules ki ghair mutawazin (asymmetric) shakal (masalan helical). Aise crystal ke chand millimetre plane of polarization ko kai degree ghuma dete hain.
Istemal: rotation concentration par munhasir hai, is liye optical activity se mehlool (jaise cheeni ke mehlool) ki concentration maloom ki jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.1 When an unpolarized light of intensity I₀ is incident on a polarizing sheet, find the intensity of light which does not get transmitted. (Ans: I₀/2)
Jab I₀ intensity ki unpolarized roshni polarizing sheet par pare to us roshni ki intensity maloom karein jo nahi guzarti.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: unpolarized roshni ki intensity = I₀
Maloom karna: na guzarne wali intensity = ?
Unpolarized roshni mein electric vibrations har simt mein hoti hain; tamam angles par cos²θ ki average = 1/2, is liye polarizing sheet aadhi roshni guzarti hai:
I(guzarne wali) = I₀ × (cos²θ ki average) = I₀/2
I(na guzarne wali) = I₀ − I₀/2
Jawab: I₀/2 nahi guzarti (jazb ho jati hai). Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.2 A polarized light beam passes through a polarizer at an angle of 45°. Find the intensity of the transmitted light if the initial intensity is 100 W m⁻². (Ans: 50 W m⁻²)
Polarized roshni ki beam 45° ke angle par polarizer se guzarti hai. Agar shuru ki intensity 100 W m⁻² ho to guzarne wali roshni ki intensity maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: I₀ = 100 W m⁻², θ = 45°
Maloom karna: I = ?
Formula (Malus ka qanoon): I = I₀cos²θ
Qeemat dalne par: I = 100 × cos²45° = 100 × (0.707)² = 100 × 0.5
Jawab: I = 50 W m⁻². Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.3 A light wave passes through a polarizer with its electric field aligned at 30° to the horizontal. If the amplitude of the wave is 10 units, what is the amplitude of the wave passing through the polarizer? (Ans: 8.66 units)
Roshni ki wave polarizer se guzarti hai jab us ki electric field horizontal se 30° par hai. Agar wave ka amplitude 10 units ho to polarizer se guzarne wali wave ka amplitude kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: A₀ = 10 units, θ = 30° (electric field aur polarizer ke axis ka angle; axis horizontal maana gaya)
Maloom karna: A = ?
Formula: sirf axis ke sath wala component guzarta hai: A = A₀cosθ
Qeemat dalne par: A = 10 × cos30° = 10 × 0.866
Jawab: A = 8.66 units. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.4 What angle is required between the direction of polaroid light and the axis of a polaroid filter to reduce its intensity by 85%? (Ans: 67.5°)
Polarized roshni ki simt aur polaroid filter ke axis ke darmiyan kitna angle ho ke intensity 85% kam ho jaye?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: intensity 85% kam, is liye I = (100% − 85%) I₀ = 0.15 I₀
Maloom karna: θ = ?
Formula: I = I₀cos²θ
0.15 I₀ = I₀cos²θ
cos²θ = 0.15
cosθ = √0.15 = 0.387
θ = cos⁻¹(0.387)
Jawab: θ ≈ 67.2°. Kitab 67.5° likhti hai (neeche box dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab (Ans: 67.5°) chhapti hai. cos²θ = 0.15 se cosθ = 0.387 aur θ = 67.2° banta hai (cos 67.5° = 0.383 se cos²θ = 0.146, yani 85.4% kami). Sahi jawab 67.2° hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.5 An unpolarized light having intensity of 15 W m⁻² is incident on a pair of polarizers. The first polaroid filter has its transmission axis at 50° from the vertical. The second polaroid filter has its transmission axis at 20° from the vertical. Calculate the intensity of light transmitted to both filters. (Ans: 7.5 W m⁻², 5.6 W m⁻² respectively)
15 W m⁻² intensity ki unpolarized roshni do polarizers par parti hai. Pehle filter ka transmission axis vertical se 50° par aur doosre ka 20° par hai. Dono filters se guzarne wali roshni ki intensity maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: I₀ = 15 W m⁻² (unpolarized), filter 1 ka axis vertical se 50°, filter 2 ka axis 20°
Maloom karna: I₁ (filter 1 ke baad) aur I₂ (filter 2 ke baad)
Step 1: Unpolarized roshni pehle filter se aadhi ho jati hai:
I₁ = I₀/2 = 15/2 = 7.5 W m⁻²
Step 2: Dono transmission axes ka angle: θ = 50° − 20° = 30°
Malus ka qanoon: I₂ = I₁cos²θ = 7.5 × cos²30° = 7.5 × (0.866)² = 7.5 × 0.75
I₂ = 5.625 W m⁻²
Jawab: I₁ = 7.5 W m⁻², I₂ ≈ 5.6 W m⁻². Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Malus ke qanoon mein θ hamesha dono axes ke darmiyan ka angle hai, vertical se angle nahi. Is liye 50° − 20° = 30° liya gaya.

blocks.prompt:
8.6 Two polarizing sheets have their polarizing directions parallel so that intensity of emitted light is maximum. Through what angle must either sheet be rotated if the intensity is to be dropped by half? (Ans: 45°)
Do polarizing sheets ki simtein parallel hain is liye roshni sab se zyada hai. Kisi ek sheet ko kitna ghumaya jaye ke intensity aadhi reh jaye?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: shuru mein parallel, I = I₀ (sab se zyada); chahiye I = I₀/2
Maloom karna: θ = ?
Formula: I = I₀cos²θ
I₀/2 = I₀cos²θ
cos²θ = 1/2
cosθ = 1/√2 = 0.707
θ = cos⁻¹(0.707)
Jawab: θ = 45°. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.7 We wish to use a glass plate of refractive index of 1.5 in air as a polarizer. Find the polarizing angle and angle of refraction. (Ans: 56.3°, 33.7° respectively)
Hawa mein 1.5 refractive index wali glass plate ko polarizer banana hai. Polarizing angle aur angle of refraction maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: n = 1.5 (medium 1 hawa hai)
Maloom karna: θₚ = ?, θᵣ = ?
Formula (Brewster ka qanoon): tan θₚ = n
θₚ = tan⁻¹(1.5)
θₚ = 56.3°
Polarizing angle par reflected aur refracted rays perpendicular hoti hain: θₚ + θᵣ = 90°
θᵣ = 90° − 56.3°
θᵣ = 33.7°
Jawab: θₚ = 56.3°, θᵣ = 33.7°. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.8 At what angle of incidence, will light reflected from water be completely polarized? (Ans: 53°)
Kis angle of incidence par paani se reflect roshni mukammal polarized hogi?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: paani ka refractive index n = 1.33 (sawal mein nahi diya; aam maaruf qeemat), roshni hawa se aa rahi hai
Maloom karna: θₚ = ?
Formula (Brewster ka qanoon): tan θₚ = n
θₚ = tan⁻¹(1.33)
θₚ = 53.1°
Jawab: θₚ ≈ 53°. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
8.9 A beam of unpolarized light is incident on a stack of four polarizing sheets that are lined up so that the characteristic direction of each is rotated by 30° clockwise with respect to the preceding sheet. What fraction in percentage of the incident intensity be transmitted? (Ans: 21%)
Unpolarized roshni chaar polarizing sheets ke dher par parti hai; har sheet pichhli se 30° clockwise ghoomi hui hai. Shuru ki intensity ka kitna feesad (percentage) guzrega?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: I₀ intensity ki unpolarized roshni; 4 sheets, har ek ka axis pichhli se 30°
Maloom karna: I₄/I₀ (% mein) = ?
Sheet 1: unpolarized roshni aadhi: I₁ = I₀/2
Sheet 2: I₂ = I₁cos²30° = (I₀/2)(0.75)
Sheet 3: I₃ = I₂cos²30° = (I₀/2)(0.75)²
Sheet 4: I₄ = I₃cos²30° = (I₀/2)(0.75)³
I₄ = (I₀/2)(0.4219) = 0.211 I₀
Feesad = 0.211 × 100%
Jawab: taqreeban 21% intensity guzarti hai. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Pehli sheet par Malus ka qanoon nahi lagta kyunke roshni unpolarized hai; woh sirf aadhi karti hai. Us ke baad har sheet par cos²30° = 0.75 se zarb dete jayein.

blocks.prompt:
8.10 A polarizer and an analyzer have their axes aligned at 60°. What is the fraction of the initial intensity that emerges? (Ans: 0.25)
Polarizer aur analyzer ke axes 60° par hain. Shuru ki intensity ka kitna hissa (fraction) nikalta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: polarizer aur analyzer ke axes ka angle θ = 60°; shuru ki intensity I₀ = analyzer tak pohnchne wali polarized roshni ki intensity
Maloom karna: I/I₀ = ?
Formula (Malus ka qanoon): I = I₀cos²θ
I/I₀ = cos²60° = (0.5)²
Jawab: I/I₀ = 0.25. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.
(Agar I₀ polarizer par parne wali unpolarized roshni ho to fraction ½ × 0.25 = 0.125 hoga.)

blocks.prompt:
8.11 If the gravitational waves have a wavelength of 3000 km, then find their frequency assuming it moves with the speed of light? (Ans: 100 Hz)
Agar gravitational waves ki wavelength 3000 km ho aur woh roshni ki speed se chalein to un ki frequency maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: λ = 3000 km = 3 × 10⁶ m, v = c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹
Maloom karna: f = ?
Formula: v = fλ, is liye f = c/λ
Qeemat dalne par: f = (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹) / (3 × 10⁶ m)
f = 1 × 10² s⁻¹
Jawab: f = 100 Hz. Kitab ke jawab se milta hai.

items: Numericals: 8.4 mein kitab ka jawab 67.5° hai, sahi 67.2° hai ("Kitab ki ghalti" box); baqi das ke jawab kitab se milte hain.
Short, constructed response aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab upar har sawal ke saath hain.
